# Bid the void, the method, and the access.

> Price a mudjacking or polyjacking job from slab area, void depth, method, access path, extra holes, and joint seal — not a published $4.50-per-square-foot special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
